subject: Intro: GreenArc Logistics — product fit + demo scheduling
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-12-05T08:47:00-08:00
Subject: Warm intro — GreenArc (referred by OnboardEdge)

Priyom / Ben —

Quick intro: Natalie Kim from OnboardEdge referred GreenArc Logistics (contact: Taylor Brooks) as a good fit for our dedicated and hosted inference patterns — they run containerized deployment pipelines for route optimization and are evaluating latency/cost tradeoffs. Natalie gave a short summary and asked that we coordinate a technical demo + short discovery.

Key context from OnboardEdge: they help GreenArc with systems integrations and will attend the first call as a trusted SI — their pre-check indicates interest in Dedicated for predictable throughput and a private deployment down the road. Natalie attached a one-page partner summary (sent separately).

Please reach out to Taylor to schedule a 45-min discovery + demo. Ben — you’re the best AE match; Priyom, can you own scheduling and the calendar coordination?

Thanks,
Marissa
---
Marissa Cole
Partner Programs
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Taylor Brooks <taylor.brooks@greenarc.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Natalie Kim <natalie@onboardedge.com>
Date: 2026-12-05T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Intro: GreenArc Logistics — product fit + demo scheduling

Hi Taylor —

Thanks for the quick intro, Marissa (and Natalie!). Great to meet you, Taylor — I’m Priyom on the SDR team at Redwood and I’ll coordinate scheduling. Ben (AE) and Soojin (solutions engineer) will join the call. Could you share a couple of windows that work this week or early next week? We typically run a 35–45 minute session that includes: quick discovery (10–15m), short demo (15–20m), and time for Q&A and next steps.

Options from our side (all PST):
- Wed 2026-12-07: 10:00–11:00 or 14:00–15:00
- Thu 2026-12-08: 09:30–10:15 or 13:00–13:45
- Mon 2026-12-12: 11:00–11:45

If these don’t work, send a couple windows and your timezone and we’ll flex. Also attaching a short agenda template and a lightweight requirements PDF — if you have any specific datasets or latency targets you want us to focus on, drop a note.

Thanks,
Priyom

Attachments: agenda-template.docx, greenarc-reqs.pdf

From: Taylor Brooks <taylor.brooks@greenarc.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Natalie Kim <natalie@onboardedge.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-12-06T12:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Intro: GreenArc Logistics — product fit + demo scheduling

Hi Priyom —

Thanks — appreciate the agenda and options. Quick note on availability and constraints: we’re PST as well, but our ops lead will only be available after lunch most days due to routing checks. Best options for us this week are Thu 2026-12-08 13:00–13:45 or Fri 2026-12-09 10:00–10:45. If you can do Thu 13:00 that’s ideal.

For scope: we want to focus on latency for 2–5k QPS bursts, support for model variants, and how caching/prefix strategies would work with our existing pipeline. Also curious about on-prem/private deployment gating.

Thanks,
Taylor

Taylor Brooks
Head of Infrastructure
GreenArc Logistics
(taylor.brooks@greenarc.com)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Confirmed — Redwood demo for GreenArc (Thu 13:00 PST)

Taylor — thanks, Thu 2026-12-08 13:00–13:45 PST works for us. I’ll send a calendar invite with a short agenda and a meeting link. Should we make this a Zoom with screen share, or do you prefer Google Meet?

Draft agenda (feel free to edit):
1) Intros & objectives (5m)
2) Discovery — current pipeline + latency targets (10m)
3) Live demo — hosted + dedicated patterns, smart routing, KV/prefix caching (20m)
4) Q&A & next steps (10m)

Action items:
- Priyom: send calendar invite + meeting link (done)
- Taylor: share any sample latency numbers or a short notes doc (optional)
- Natalie/OnboardEdge: attend and support integration discussion

I’ve attached the agenda-template we’ll use; Priyom included the requirements PDF earlier. See you Thu.

—
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
